92a45e8cb3.q: Why does SPIS not use AI or artificial intelligence for background investigations?
92a45e8cb3.a: Paul Baker explains that Texas has 254 counties, each with its own county clerk and district clerk maintaining misdemeanor and felony records separately, creating over 500 separate entities. No single database exists that maintains every criminal record from misdemeanor class B through first degree felony. Additionally, many counties still lack Internet access to their records, requiring physical courthouse visits, so a complete unified AI system cannot yet function effectively.
